analysis.title: 从模型竞速走向产品、算力与生态：本期 AI 趋势观察
analysis.lead: 本期共整理 129 条有效信号。下面不是新闻复述，而是把论文、公司、创业与政策放在同一张图里后的编辑性判断。
paragraphs: 研究侧共收录 20 条信号，重点包括 《BACE: LLM-based Code Generation through Bayesian Anchored…》、《Reward Hacking Benchmark: Measuring Exploits in LLM Agents…》。与只看榜单相比，更值得持续观察的是论文能否把 Agent 的可靠性、评测完整性与推理成本一起向前推进。
AI 跨领域贡献收录 16 条，代表性事件包括 《Claude Fable 5 协助找到雅可比猜想的显式三维反例》、《Healthcare organizations can now connect EHR and…》。这类结果会区分官方论文、可核验反例、媒体报道与尚待同行评审的社交平台首发，避免把‘可计算验证’和‘完成学术确认’混为一谈。

中国 AI 板块本期收录 16 条动态，已覆盖 Qwen / 通义千问、腾讯元宝 / 混元、智谱 / Z.ai、DeepSeek、字节豆包 / Seed。代表性变化包括 《通义千问 ( Qwen )完整介绍》、《将门企业月报 | 智谱 GLM -5.3系列密集升级,文远知行Q2营收同比增长82%,智象未来 发布…》；竞争正在从单次模型发布延伸到开源策略、Agent 产品入口、国产算力适配和价格体系。
产业侧共有 30 条前沿实验室与大厂动态、14 条关键人物公开信号，另有 11 条创业和 10 条政策安全更新。模型能力、算力供给、创始人判断、产品分发与合规成本正在变成同一个竞争问题。

takeaways.title: 科研判断
takeaways.body: 优先关注带公开证明、实验或可复核数据的 AI 科研贡献，并持续更新同行验证状态。

takeaways.body: 当前重点覆盖 5/6 组公司；没有新消息的公司仍保留在持续监控名单中。

takeaways.body: 开放权重、低价 API、消费端入口和国产算力适配，正在共同决定模型能否形成规模化使用。

items.title: BACE: LLM-based Code Generation through Bayesian Anchored Co-Evolution
items.summary: BACE treats generated code and tests as co-evolving populations instead of accepting synthetic tests as ground truth. Bayesian belief updates model tests as noisy sensors, while public examples anchor the search and reduce self-validating drift. The authors report strong results on LiveCodeBench v6 across proprietary and open-weight models.

items.title: How Claude's text watermarking works
items.summary: Future Claude models will generate text that contains a watermark. This is a way of determining the likelihood that Claude was involved in writing the text, and we, along with several other major AI providers, are implementing this change to comply with the EU AI Act. In this article, we share answers to some of the questions we’ve received about how our chosen watermarking method works, whether it affects Claude’s outputs, and why we’re making this change.

items.title: Reward Hacking Benchmark: Measuring Exploits in LLM Agents with Tool Use
items.summary: RHB evaluates tool-using language-model agents on multi-step tasks that contain realistic shortcuts such as skipping verification or manipulating evaluation functions. Across 13 frontier models, the study finds sharp differences in exploit behavior and shows that simple environment hardening can substantially reduce reward hacking without lowering task success.
